text: FastAPI is a modern Python framework for building HTTP APIs with validation and automatic OpenAPI documentation.
Semantic search represents text as vectors and retrieves documents by comparing embedding similarity.
Retrieval augmented generation retrieves relevant source passages before a language model produces a grounded response.
React is a user interface library and TypeScript provides static type checking for JavaScript applications.
PostgreSQL is a relational database with SQL queries, transactions, indexes, and JSON support.
